name: China Travel International Investment Hong Kong Limited
summary: China Travel International Investment Hong Kong Limited provides travel and tourism services. It operates through four segments: Tourist Attraction and Related Operations, Travel Document and Related Operations, Hotel Operations, and Passenger Transportation Operations. The Tourist Attraction and Related Operations segment operates theme parks, natural and cultural scenic spots in Mainland China. The Travel Document and Related Operations segment engages in the provision of travel document and related services in Hong Kong and Mainland China.
